coordinateConvention: sourceCorners are normalized PNG coordinates, origin top-left; top corners ordered cell(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(0,1); wall corners ordered lowA,lowB,highB,highA

selection.shapeFrom: lowA, lowB, highB, highA; actual endpoint heights, including tapered side of a ramp

notes: Source corner measurements are approximate; review borders before production.
Map source artwork UV onto actual projected quad. Do not use SquareUV or legacy 65x33 diamond UV for these PNGs.
One ramp image supplies four prototype surface mappings, not four independently lit artworks. Dedicated directional variants can replace each entry later.
Cliff corner joins use existing independent edge faces; no full cube sprite needed.
Do not assume ramp height delta is one tier: use actual CellHeight low/high values.
Do not add cliff grass top: ground is a separate draw.
Full PNG rect includes transparent padding; pivot must be derived from cell anchor and source quad, not rect center.
No collider, no simulation height change; shader is only texture/alpha and virtual depth.
Higher walls and mountain fractional heights can warp the reference face. For production, tier repeats or specific height variants may be preferable.
